status: Independent semantic acoustic windows authored; native-dependent settling, accent controls, synchronization and lifecycle protocols explicitly blocked. No runtime acceptance claim; see tests/acid/audio_capture_evidence.md.
step_unit: one straight TIME sixteenth; 1 step = 2 phrase lines at phrase LPB 8

normalization.comparisons: recalibrate under the same documented normalization policy; match A/B gain where possible and compensate measured ratios for actual gains
normalization.method: one positive scalar applied equally to every sample and channel; optional explicitly recorded mono average only when source stereo difference is <= -40 dB; no time edits, resampling, compression, denoising or limiting
normalization.policy: explicit analysis copies only; retain unchanged original WAV
normalization.optional_mono: recorded arithmetic mean of L/R, source stereo difference <= -40 dB; mono-copy evidence does not qualify original stereo channel agreement

playback.calibration_marker: OFF on each step second line (50% marker gate); capture-only timing marker, not M3 gate evidence

cases.trigger: one sustained host note starts the calibration phrase; each calibration NOTE is cut by a calibration-only OFF at the half-step point; capture one cold pass and three steady repeats
